description: A painted courtroom scene. An elderly bald man with glasses, in a black coat, points with one hand and holds a rolled paper in the other, facing a row of older men in black robes seated at a curved wooden bench on the right. On the left, a group of Black men and women in worn, plain clothing sit and watch. The room has a stone arched ceiling, brick walls, a glowing window, gas wall lamps and a gallery of standing spectators. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
